capabilities: Render BattleSnake JSON board positions as SVG in preview
Trigger rendering via a battlesnake code block
Produce output suitable for HTML and PDF export
extras: The README explicitly states the plugin is visualization-only: no interactivity and no handling of entire games. No planned features are listed.
problem: Obsidian has no way to visualize BattleSnake board positions stored as JSON; the JSON alone is hard to read.

relations.evidence: Original code framework from Obsidian Chess Plugin

summary: Renders BattleSnake JSON board positions as SVG diagrams in note preview, optimized for visualization and HTML/PDF export.
